{{Top|leg}}
The '''SRG-87 railgun drone''' was a [[Drone/Legends|drone]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic War]] that could be carried as a payload by [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. Designed as a cheap alternative to full-sized [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], the SRG-87 was mounted with a [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]] that provided short-duration, long-range fire against enemy starships.
